Artigo científico · 2025

Wave and vibration attenuation in graded elastic metamaterial beams with local resonators

Gomes, C. B. F.; Dos Santos, M. C. P.; Araujo, B. C. C.; Pereira, F. N.; Nobrega, E. D.; Dos Santos, J. M. C.; Miranda Jr., E. J. P.; Sinatora, A.

International Journal of Mechanical Sciences · v. 293 · 110125

Ver publicação ↗

Abstract

This work investigates wave propagation and vibration attenuation in elastic metamaterial beams containing locally resonant elements with graded properties. The results show how spatial grading can redistribute attenuation zones and improve the low-frequency dynamic performance of the beam.
